description: This file defines the OsHelper class in the Api\V8\Helper namespace. It provides a static method to determine the operating system type (Windows, Linux, OSX) at runtime.

classes.name: Api\V8\Helper\OsHelper
classes.description: A helper class to detect the operating system type at runtime.

methods.name: getOS
methods.description: Returns a string indicating the operating system ('WINDOWS', 'LINUX', 'OSX') or throws an exception if it cannot be determined.

methods.name: getOS
methods.description: Returns the current operating system as a string, or throws RuntimeException if unable to determine.
